_comment: Durable QUESTIONS, not answers. Each entry says which typed proposition is
worth checking in this part of the architecture; Sensei recomputes whether it
holds against the world being assessed, every time.
This file is inert. A recipe on its own provides ZERO coverage — it must be
revalidated by `sensei derive` in the assessed world before it anchors
anything. That is why it is safe to commit and safe to let an agent write:
the worst a forged entry achieves is spending one derivation.
What persists here is the judgment-bearing half an investigation produced —
knowing WHICH relationship is worth checking. The answer is cheap to recompute.

recipes.why: internal/event/bus.go answered PREFLIGHT_STATUS_EMPTY with 'no anchored rules apply'. A closure round read the code and found the discipline worth checking: Publish sends under RLock while the Subscribe cancel closes under Lock. Whether that is WHY the lock exists is a purpose claim no derivation establishes.

applyPremiseResolutions and premiseReceiptFor access the receipt collection while holding Engine.mu; mechanically checking that ownership relationship would cover the state involved in replacing repeated scans with a direct receipt-ID index.
